description: This file defines the ZipStream class for creating streamed, dynamically generated ZIP archives, including methods for adding files, handling ZIP64, and streaming output with HTTP headers.

classes.name: ZipStream
classes.description: Class for creating and streaming ZIP archives with support for large files and HTTP streaming.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ZipStream object with optional filename and archive options.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file to the ZIP archive from a string of data.

methods.name: addFileFromPath
methods.description: Adds a file to the ZIP archive from a file path on disk.

methods.name: addFileFromStream
methods.description: Adds a file to the ZIP archive from a stream resource.

methods.name: addFileFromPsr7Stream
methods.description: Adds a file to the ZIP archive from a PSR-7 StreamInterface.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the ZIP archive and writes the footer.

methods.name: packFields
methods.description: Creates a binary string for pack() from an array of field definitions.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Outputs a string to the stream, sending HTTP headers if needed.

methods.name: isLargeFile
methods.description: Checks if a file exceeds the large file size threshold.

methods.name: addToCdr
methods.description: Adds file attributes to the central directory record.

methods.name: addCdr64Eof
methods.description: Sends ZIP64 central directory record end-of-file.

methods.name: sendHttpHeaders
methods.description: Sends HTTP headers for the ZIP stream.

methods.name: addCdr64Locator
methods.description: Sends ZIP64 central directory record locator.

methods.name: addCdrEof
methods.description: Sends the central directory record end-of-file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal variables after finishing the archive.
